title: Translate desktop launcher errors
changes: Translate missing-executable, process-launch and unsuccessful-exit messages into English for the default dialog and play-error.log, preserving process handling and captured output.
validation: rustfmt parsed the launcher source; inspected the diff to confirm only three diagnostic strings changed. Attempted cargo check --offline --locked -p ffta-play --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu; the build script failed with OS error 2 while compiling the Windows icon resource.
limitations: Windows compilation and graphical error dialogs remain unverified because the icon resource build step failed in this environment; no ROM was used.
